parameters.query:
UPDATE missions SET
  status = 'COMPLETED_PRESENT',
  outcome_notes = '{{ $json.notes }}',
  completed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.mission_id }}
RETURNING id, ats_candidate_id, mission_date;

UPDATE missions SET
  status = 'COMPLETED_ABSENT',
  outcome_notes = '{{ $json.notes }}',
  completed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.mission_id }}
RETURNING id, ats_candidate_id, mission_date;

UPDATE missions SET
  status = 'COMPLETED_LATE',
  arrival_time = '{{ $('Set - Normalize Outcome').item.json.arrival_time }}',
  outcome_notes = '{{ $('Set - Normalize Outcome').item.json.notes }}',
  completed_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $('Set - Normalize Outcome').item.json.mission_id }}
RETURNING id, ats_candidate_id, mission_date;

SELECT
  c.id AS candidate_id, c.ats_candidate_id,
  c.name, c.phone, c.email,
  c.absence_rate, c.late_rate, c.no_reply_count,
  c.reliability_score, c.total_missions_count,
  c.present_count, c.absent_count, c.late_count
FROM candidates c
JOIN missions m ON m.ats_candidate_id = c.ats_candidate_id
WHERE m.id = {{ $json.id }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  c.id AS candidate_id, c.ats_candidate_id,
  c.name, c.phone, c.email,
  c.absence_rate, c.late_rate, c.no_reply_count,
  c.reliability_score, c.total_missions_count,
  c.present_count, c.absent_count, c.late_count
FROM candidates c
JOIN missions m ON m.ats_candidate_id = c.ats_candidate_id
WHERE m.id = {{ $json.id }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  c.id AS candidate_id, c.ats_candidate_id,
  c.name, c.phone, c.email,
  c.absence_rate, c.late_rate, c.no_reply_count,
  c.reliability_score, c.total_missions_count,
  c.present_count, c.absent_count, c.late_count
FROM candidates c
JOIN missions m ON m.ats_candidate_id = c.ats_candidate_id
WHERE m.id = {{ $json.id }}
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE candidates SET
  total_missions_count = {{ $json.new_total }},
  present_count = {{ $json.new_present }},
  absent_count = {{ $json.new_absent }},
  late_count = {{ $json.new_late }},
  absence_rate = {{ $json.new_absence_rate }},
  late_rate = {{ $json.new_late_rate }},
  reliability_score = {{ $json.new_reliability_score }},
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.candidate_id }};
